description.en: Tencent Docs in the DSH left sidebar: one click opens your real recent files, the folder tree (drill down, breadcrumbs, title search) and a local link list, read live over Tencent Docs' official MCP endpoint. A token pasted once is stored on the host side only (0600), never in the page; files open in a new tab because Tencent Docs forbids third-party embedding.
description.zh: 把腾讯文档放进 DSH 左侧栏：点一下就能看真实的最近文件、逐层下钻的目录树（含面包屑与标题搜索）和一个本机链接清单，数据经腾讯文档官方 MCP 端点实时读取。令牌粘贴一次、只由 Host 半落盘（0600），页面脚本读不到；腾讯文档禁止第三方嵌入，文件在新标签打开。
